levels.effect: You suffer one less penalty (minimum -1) when attempting a Force power while also making a Lightsaber Combat attack or defense in the same turn. You gain a +1 bonus to Will rolls when using Force powers in combat.

conditional.when: on Will rolls when using Force powers in combat

levels.effect: You suffer one less penalty (minimum 0) when attempting a Force power while also making a Lightsaber Combat attack or defense. You gain a +2 bonus to Will rolls when using Force powers in combat. You can maintain two Force powers at once (if they allow maintenance) by paying the combined FP cost for both.

conditional.when: on Will rolls when using Force powers in combat

levels.effect: You can attempt a Force power and make a Lightsaber Combat attack/defense in the same turn with no penalty to either action. You gain a +3 bonus to Will rolls when using Force powers in combat. You can maintain two Force powers with a single FP cost as if they were one, as long as they are related (GM's discretion).

conditional.when: on Will rolls when using Force powers in combat

levels.effect: You can attempt a Force power and make a Lightsaber Combat attack/defense in the same turn with no penalty to either action, and gain a +1 bonus to your Lightsaber Combat skill roll if you successfully cast a Force power that turn. You gain a +4 bonus to Will rolls when using Force powers in combat. You can use two different Force powers in the same turn (one as an attack, one as a defense, or two attack rolls) at -1 penalty to each.

conditional.when: on Will rolls when using Force powers in combat
on Lightsaber Combat, if you successfully cast a Force power that turn
